story.title: Story 4: Generated PI Session Target Metadata

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 4 generated-session target metadata against the story, the full Session Context Store tech design, and the test plan. Reviewed the target/projection metadata implementation in `thread-service.ts`, `file-thread-store.ts`, and the record contracts, checked the mapped `thread-store.test.ts` coverage plus related foundation defaults, and ran the configured story and epic gates.
additionalObservations: `src/context-steward/services/thread-service.ts` now refreshes projection-summary state after optional revision writes, while `src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts` keeps `target.currentGeneratedFilePath` separate from the latest projection-summary path; the added `thread-store.test.ts` cases cover both behaviors and the existing Story 4 tests still prove source ordering stays anchored to `messages.jsonl`.

`npm run verify-all` exited successfully; its integration phase reported `No integration tests found.`, but Story 4's required TC coverage is explicitly mapped to `tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts` in the test plan.
Production-path audit found no fake adapters, shim branches, placeholder behavior, or generated-session content reads in the reviewed Story 4 runtime paths.
